names.title: Names to screen
names.description: People, organizations or vessels to screen. Each name is screened against every selected sanctions list and returns one result record.

lists.title: Sanctions lists
lists.description: Which official lists to screen against: OFAC_SDN (US Treasury SDN list), EU (EU consolidated financial sanctions list), UK (FCDO UK Sanctions List), UN (UN Security Council consolidated list). Price is the same per name however many lists you select. Leave empty for all four.

minScore.title: Minimum match score
minScore.description: Match threshold in percent (100 = exact only). 85 is a sensible compliance default.

includeAliases.title: Screen against aliases (AKAs)
includeAliases.description: Also match against official alternate names, spelling variations and transliterations on every selected list.
